messages:
maria: Observed a spike of streaming disconnects on eu-edge for ~40m. Proxy logs show delayed ACKs -> router evicts lease -> route swap -> client reconnects and resume token mismatches. Ops alerted.
kevin: Any recent routing or proxy changes? paste a small log sample. @june
june: We rolled route-policy v2 to eu at 15:55 yesterday (canary -> 50%). Main change: sticky-lease timeout lowered for hot shards.
maria: Logs (sanitized):
```
[eu-proxy-9] 2026-03-23T16:10:05Z INFO ack_delayed route_swap=true session=abc123 resume=RID-456
[router-4] 2026-03-23T16:10:06Z WARN lease_evicted session=abc123 old_shard=s-09 new_shard=s-22
[ingest] 2026-03-23T16:10:07Z ERROR client_reconnect id=cid-890 code=1006
```
maria: Sequence: proxy delays ACK, shorter sticky-lease triggers eviction before frame arrives, router swaps shard, resume invalidated, reconnect uses new resume and billing counts twice.
telemetry-bot: Quick correlate: region=eu & policy=v2 -> connect_failures up ~4.6x since 15:58.
june: v2 dropped sticky-lease from 30s -> 8s for busy shards to free capacity. That likely created the window.
kevin: Two action areas: (1) telemetry/console blind spots: late ACKs and lease evictions not surfaced; (2) billing guardrail to prevent duplicate charges on quick resume loops.
telemetry-bot: Short-term: add metrics streaming.late_ack_rate and streaming.lease_eviction_rate (per-region, per-policy) and a staging dashboard tile. Backfill query: SELECT count(*) FROM stream_events WHERE region='eu' AND event IN ('ack_delayed','lease_evicted','resume_mismatch') AND ts >= '2026-03-23T15:50:00Z';
june: Immediate rollback plan: revert sticky-lease timeout change for the canary cohort to 30s, then re-evaluate with proxy ack p95. I'll open a rollback PR.
maria: Mitigation: router patch to apply 2s grace when seeing ack_delayed before evicting lease. Can we hotpatch? Need tests.
kevin: Also add a temporary billing safety: if resume_count for a session >1 within 10s, flag and hold billing pending review. Finance/ops to sign off.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20260323-89 created: "eu-edge late-ack lease evictions causing reconnects & duplicate billing". Pager duty notified.
telemetry-bot: Tracked actions: backfill query, new metrics + staging dashboard, router grace patch + tests, temporary billing hold.
maria: I'll collect session traces and attach them to incident. Thanks. :thumbsup:
